decl.text:
geCopySelSet( [
w_windowId ] [ l_sourcePt ]
[ l_destPt ]
)
=> t / nil

description.text: Procedural interface to copy the selected set.

items.name: w_windowId
items.desc: Window ID of the window to use. If not specified, the current window is used.

items.name: l_sourcePt
items.desc: The starting point for the copy.

items.name: l_destPt
items.desc: The destination point for the copy.

arguments.text:
w_windowId
Window ID of the window to use. If not specified, the current window is used.
l_sourcePt
The starting point for the copy.
l_destPt
The destination point for the copy.

items.desc: The selected objects are not copied.

returns.text:
t
The selected objects are copied.
nil
The selected objects are not copied.

example.text:
geCopySelSet(hiGetCurrentWindow()list(456.7 234.5)list(678.9 567.8))
Copies objects in the selected set from the current window to the current window.

interactive_function.text: Enter this function with only the window ID argument; the system prompts you for the starting and destination point that encloses the objects to be copied. If w_windowId is not specified, the current window is used.
